expected_level_description: You can: - design the governance framework and advise the board - lead annual governance reporting and assurance
You can: - design the organisation's risk management framework and appetite - advise the board on strategic risks
You can: - design the organisation's assurance framework - advise the audit committee and board on the strength of assurance
You can: - set the policy framework for the organisation - advise the board on policy priorities and risks
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession
You can: - track spending against a small budget and raise variances - authorise spending within your limit
You can: - act as a point of escalation - be trusted by senior risk owners as an expert in security - apply risk methodologies at the most complex levels of risk

You can: - make decisions characterised by medium levels of risk and complexity and recommend decisions as risk and complexity increase - build consensus between services or independent stakeholders - identify problems or issues in the team dynamic and rectify them - engage in varying types of feedback, choosing the right type at the appropriate time and ensuring the discussion and decision stick - bring people together to form a motivated team and help create the right environment for a team to work in - facilitate the best team makeup depending on the situation
